note: This is the offline fallback. The real registry is read from PMS by scripts/kpi_registry.py --refresh, which overwrites ids, names, thresholds and the official descriptions with whatever PMS says today, and fills 'projects' with the per-project targets PMS holds. Thresholds in 'kpis' are the PMS DEFAULTS; a project that sets its own in PMS appears under 'projects' and wins. Treat anything here as 'what PMS said in September 2026' and refresh before a run that matters. If PMS adds a KPI, the refresh picks it up and the engine reports it as unsupported rather than silently ignoring it.

kpis.name: Velocity
kpis.description_pms: Work completed in the period, measured in the project's unit of estimation.
kpis.basis: Sum of the effort of every item delivered in the period, plus team-level effort that is not attributable to a single item.
kpis.heading: Work finished in this cycle
kpis.formula_pms: Total work completed in the period (story points / hours).

kpis.name: Task Comprehension
kpis.description_pms: Share of tasks the team understood from the requirement without needing clarification from the client.
kpis.basis: Every item worked on in the period - plan items and approved additions alike. Items with no history of their own are left out of the denominator.
kpis.heading: Requirements the team understood without asking the client
kpis.formula_pms: Understood task count / Total task count

kpis.name: Client Expectation
kpis.description_pms: Share of work delivered by the date the client expected.
kpis.basis: Items whose client-expected date was met, over the items whose date has been settled. Items not yet due are Pending and left out of the denominator.
kpis.heading: Work the client expected by {date}

kpis.name: Delivery Commitment
kpis.description_pms: Team-negotiated commitments that were delivered on time. Formula: task count delivered on time / total team-committed task count. Insight: reliability of the team.
kpis.basis: Only items the team actually committed to. An item nobody promised a date for is not evidence of reliability either way, so it is left out and named. What counts as delivering a commitment is set per team - delivery to QA, delivery to the client, or completion - because teams commit to different things.
kpis.heading: Commitments the team met on time
kpis.formula_pms: Delivered on time (committed) / Total team-committed tasks

kpis.name: Defect Rate
kpis.description_pms: Defects found in the work delivered, relative to the volume delivered.
kpis.basis: Counted defects over delivered items. Rejected reports never count. Observations, improvements and pre-existing defects count only if the team's counting rules say so.
kpis.heading: Bugs found in the work we delivered
kpis.formula_pms: Number of defects found / Total task count

kpis.name: Escaped Defect Rate
kpis.description_pms: Defects that reached the client instead of being caught before handover.
kpis.basis: Non-rejected defects reported after the handover, over all non-rejected defects in the period - before and after release alike. The denominator is defects, not delivered items: the question is what share of the problems reached the client, not how much work was done.
kpis.heading: Bugs the client found after handover
kpis.formula_pms: Defects found after release / Total defects (before + after release)

kpis.name: Defect Rejection Rate
kpis.description_pms: Share of reported issues that turned out not to be defects.
kpis.basis: Reports closed as invalid, by design, duplicate, not reproducible or not feasible, over all reports in the period.
kpis.heading: Reports that turned out not to be bugs

kpis.name: Rework Rate
kpis.description_pms: Tasks that had to be reopened at least once after being closed, over all completed tasks.
kpis.basis: A QA failure while the item is still being tested for the first time is normal testing, not rework: it is named in the note and left out of the count.
kpis.heading: Finished tasks that had to be reopened

kpis.name: CR Rate
kpis.description_pms: Change requests raised against the agreed scope.
kpis.basis: Approved additions over the planned items. A period made only of change requests is measured against the project's planned scope instead.
kpis.heading: Extra work the client added after the plan
